**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/25 (Thu) 13:10

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The super-siblings use their powers, such as super strength and speed, to fight the aliens.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The super-siblings assist with relief efforts using their powers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] They implement sustainable farming practices to prevent future droughts.
